items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: He was not as good a teacher as the Teal brothers.

ctx.x: How was Piku? Was he a good teacher? Who? Piku. Was he a good teacher?
He was not as good a teacher as the Teal brothers. They were good teachers. You played the Alba clarinet huh? That's right. Alba system?
